title: Pan-Seared Lentils with Stone Bowl Caramelization
description: A keto-friendly lentil dish with a nutty, caramelized crust, served in a stone bowl.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the cooked lentils and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Transfer the lentil mixture to the dolsot stone bowl.
Bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the crust is caramelized.
Remove from oven and garnish with thyme.
